title: Mistral gets eyes, and the docs get a trim
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: Mistral vision support, cleaner API guidance, and less manual link wrangling.

Mistral’s configuration now supports vision capabilities, while the API documentation was refreshed so builders have a clearer map of the available surface area.

A script now generates the affiliate list as JSON, and text.pollinations.ai can consume those JSON affiliate links. Less hand-maintained link archaeology, more structured data.

The feed-filter CLI gained Commander-based logging for easier operational debugging, while the partner directory was brought up to date.
